parrafo.es: Estudio de fotografía en Hialeah especializado en bodas, compromisos, quinceañeras, retratos familiares y sesiones de cumpleaños. Eduardo y su equipo cuidan cada detalle, desde la sesión hasta el álbum impreso que llega a tus manos.
parrafo.en: A Hialeah photography studio specialized in weddings, engagements, quinceañeras, family portraits and birthday sessions. Eduardo and his team take care of every detail, from the shoot to the printed album that reaches your hands.

hero.imagen_alt: Studio portrait on a white backdrop, photographed by M.C Studios

parrafo_1.es: M.C Studios es un estudio de fotografía en Hialeah dedicado a bodas, compromisos, quinceañeras y retratos de familia. Eduardo y Selene lideran cada sesión, desde la planificación hasta la entrega final.
parrafo_1.en: M.C Studios is a Hialeah photography studio dedicated to weddings, engagements, quinceañeras and family portraits. Eduardo and Selene lead every session, from planning through final delivery.

parrafo_2.es: Con 4.8 de calificación y 76 reseñas en Google, el trabajo habla por sí solo: familias que vuelven para las fotos de sus hijos, sus bodas y sus celebraciones, sesión tras sesión.
parrafo_2.en: With a 4.8 rating and 76 reviews on Google, the work speaks for itself: families who come back for their kids' photos, their weddings and their celebrations, session after session.

texto.es: Nos escribes o llamas y conversamos sobre el tipo de sesión: boda, quince, retrato familiar o cumpleaños. Resolvemos tus dudas antes de agendar.
texto.en: You call or message us and we talk through the type of session: wedding, quinceañera, family portrait or birthday. We answer your questions before booking.

texto.es: En estudio o en locación, Eduardo y el equipo dirigen cada toma para que te veas natural y favorecida frente a la cámara.
texto.en: In studio or on location, Eduardo and the team guide every shot so you look natural and at your best in front of the camera.

texto.es: Seleccionamos y editamos las mejores tomas, cuidando color, luz y detalle en cada imagen.
texto.en: We select and edit the best shots, taking care of color, light and detail in every image.

texto.es: Recibes tus fotos digitales y, si lo pides, un álbum impreso para conservar el recuerdo por años.
texto.en: You receive your digital photos and, if you choose, a printed album to keep the memory for years.

nota.es: Cada sesión se cotiza según el tipo de evento y la duración. Escríbenos o llama y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every session is quoted based on the type of event and length. Message or call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Fotografía y video de bodas, compromisos y aniversarios. Cubrimos desde la preparación hasta la fiesta, con equipo completo.
texto.en: Photo and video for weddings, engagements and anniversaries. We cover everything from getting ready through the reception, with a full team.

texto.es: Sesiones de quince años en estudio o en locación, con vestuario y escenarios para que tu hija brille en cada foto.
texto.en: Quinceañera sessions in studio or on location, with wardrobe and scenery so your daughter shines in every photo.

texto.es: Fotos de niños, familias y retratos individuales en estudio, con fondo profesional y resultados listos para enmarcar.
texto.en: Photos of kids, families and individual portraits in studio, with a professional backdrop and frame-ready results.

texto.es: Sesiones de cumpleaños y celebraciones especiales, documentadas con el mismo cuidado que una boda.
texto.en: Birthday and special celebration sessions, documented with the same care as a wedding.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu tipo de evento? Escríbenos igual: trabajamos sesiones a la medida.
pie.en: Do not see your type of event? Message us anyway: we build sessions around what you need.

items.quote: An absolutely incredible experience from start to finish. Eduardo is so talented and captured exactly what I was looking for. I couldn't be happier with how these turned out!!

Eduardo and his team shot our engagement photos, wedding photos and video for our 10yr vow renewal. We were wowed with the quality of their work! Our photo album is beyond beautiful and our wedding video is so beautiful and clear.

Eduardo and Selene did a fantastic job. They were very professional and collaborative during our daughter's quinceañera photo shoots. The pictures turned out spectacular. We are very delighted with their job, and I would 100% recommend it.
I went to the studio for my son's 6-year photos and I was so happy with the results that I'm planning to come back in August for my daughter's pictures.
